officialRuleCorrection.finding: Pinned Narrow Escape uses Filters.hasAbility, which invokes hasAbility(...,false) and excludes permanent pilots. The harness records false for that filter, true when including the permanent pilot, and a non-null legal move-away action when Force is available. GEMP consequently moves Han instead of the Snowspeeder. Native includes the vehicle in the original ability group and moves it with the shared journey.
officialRuleCorrection.basis: AR p71 Example 3 explicitly treats a permanent-pilot X-wing as a Narrow Escape target with ability; lack of landspeed prohibits that ship. Snowspeeder has landspeed. The same page specifies that moving a vehicle first carries targeted occupants away and prevents their separate move-away.
